description: This file implements the basic functions for the Ansc Simple System Time Object, including creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization. It defines a create function for constructing the object, a remove function for cleanup, an enrollment function to set up associated interfaces, and an initialization function to set default values and function pointers.

classes.name: ANSC_SIMPLE_SYS_TIME_OBJECT
classes.description: The main object structure implementing the Simple System Time functionality.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscSstoCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Constructs the Simple Sys Time Object, allocates memory, initializes base object properties, sets function pointers, and enrolls associated objects.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscSstoRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the object, frees associated memory, and releases locks.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscSstoEnrollObjects(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes the time interface object, and enrolls subordinate objects.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscSstoInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the object’s member variables, sets default values and function pointers.
